title: fix(cron): restore search typing performance
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Typing in Automations search repeatedly invalidates retained rows' owner-permission bindings. After #189749, the 500-job scenario rose from roughly 14 ms to 48 ms of desktop Chromium scripting.

## User Impact

Restores responsive multi-keystroke search while preserving human-owner editing, transfer, live permission changes, and the existing mutation-time authority checks. Thanks @VACInc for the owner-management feature in #189749.

## Why This Change Was Made

The permission callback was reached through the whole page's reactive props. Each search publication could re-enter the retained row controls, including speculative rendering that never became DOM mutations. The renderer now derives permission invalidation from actual Gateway/auth/identity and profile-directory changes, supplies those bindings separately, and suppresses equal per-row results. The permission policy stays with the existing owner; there is no new authorization cache or request-coalescing change.

## Evidence

The committed `cron-search-typing` scenario loads 500 jobs, types `Warm automation 0499` using `pressSequentially`, and waits for the final response and single matching row. This uses the production renderer and benchmark HTTP server with synthetic Gateway data; it makes no provider/network latency claim.

20 interleaved parent/fix/parent-control triples per viewport and engine: **240/240 passed**. Parent is `4674051ce50a` (`975e68cf820^`); its retained bundle's 6,274 file hashes were verified. Numbers are milliseconds, median / p95:

| View / engine | Metric | Feature parent | Fix | Identical-parent control |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| desktop / chromium | script CPU | 13.805 / 16.458 | 13.753 / 14.757 | 13.981 / 17.543 |
| desktop / webkit | application time | 106.000 / 115.000 | 106.500 / 119.000 | 108.500 / 115.000 |
| mobile / chromium | script CPU | 10.869 / 11.605 | 11.299 / 12.592 | 11.078 / 12.982 |
| mobile / webkit | application time | 94.000 / 104.000 | 94.000 / 102.000 | 95.000 / 105.000 |

Desktop script CPU matches the feature parent and its p95 improves 10.3%. Mobile script median is +3.95%; its p95 is +8.50%, while the identical-parent control is +11.87%. The loaded host also moved the mobile application-time control by +49.3%, so those wall-time tails are not evidence of a product regression. Host load: median 13.88, range 7.62–17.57. Against the original regressed measurements, script medians fall from 48.447→13.753 ms desktop and 22.505→11.299 ms mobile. The strict median target is met; mobile tail precision remains limited by the host. Pooling the 40 identical-parent references as a control check gives mobile script 11.007 / 12.802 ms versus 11.299 / 12.592 ms for the fix (+2.65% median, −1.64% p95). The primary per-slot comparison is preserved above.

- `pnpm tsgo:ui`: passed.
- The two changed test files, run with `--maxWorkers=1`: 9/9 passed. The retained-row work-count assertion was red before the row memo (four calls versus two); live owner/identity and admin transitions remain covered.
- Focused formatting/lint and the controller guard: passed.
- Production Knip: passed, no new ignores.
- `pnpm ui:build` and strict bundle comparison: passed. Startup **90,452→90,450 B gzip**, three JS requests and one CSS request unchanged; CSS stays 34,188 B gzip. Lazy boundaries stay intact.
- Independent Codex review: no actionable P0–P2 findings. `ci:full` requests the broad UI, browser-extension and real-Gateway CI lanes.

Production LOC: **976→1,019 (+43)** across the four changed production files. Test LOC: **294→335 (+41)**. The added derivation separates permission invalidation from search publications; it adds no subscription, effect, writable store, or lifecycle. Refactor census: memos 12→16, effects 1→1, onSettled 2→2; direct listeners, DOM queries, owner APIs, and flush calls remain zero.

## CI attribution and landing

Full CI run [41295724373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41295724373), attempt 1, tested `66a619d0b53c` merged with `b60801599640`. Two failing E2E shards contain five inherited cases; the other selected checks, including security, passed.

- **Empty workspace:** `starts an empty cloud workspace before the default folder Git check finishes` fails the same line-54 assertion in [scheduled main run 41293098118](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41293098118/job/124808390527): expected “Start in an empty folder for this session.”, received “New workspace”. Shard numbering changed; the case and assertion match.
- **Presentation primitives:** all four `Solid preserves presentation contracts in {light,dark} {desktop,mobile}` cases reproduce on the actual CI parent `b60801599640` in a single-file headless run (`pnpm test ui/src/e2e/presentation-primitives.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`). They fail the same skeleton shadow-parent style assertion at lines 175/270. Main's shimmer consolidation #189848 moved skeleton background, radius and overflow into document-global CSS. The older branch base passes; the actual CI parent fails. These inputs are unchanged by this PR.

Landing uses the authorized native inherited-failure route with hashed logs and the actual CI merge. No failing assertions are skipped or weakened.
